description: This file defines localization and culture-specific information for date formatting in Swedish (Finland). It customizes date and time formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing, timezone info, and utility functions related to date handling.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a day name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
